h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sambalpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sambalpur

items.pText: Sambalpur, on the Mahanadi in western Odisha, is known for the Hirakud dam and for its handwoven Sambalpuri textiles. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, colonies and parks in the city and across the district. We build it at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,180 km away, and send it by road for installation.

Western Odisha has some of the hottest summers in eastern India, and that affects the colours you should choose. Dark plastic left in direct sun heats up quickly, while lighter shades stay cooler. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, so you can pick a scheme that looks bright and still works in April and May. Send us the site details and we will suggest equipment and colours together.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Picking colours and positions for Sambalpur's heat

c: Use lighter shades for slide beds, seats and platforms that children touch, and keep darker shades for posts, roofs and trims. Position the equipment so the main slides face north or east, out of the direct afternoon sun, and leave existing trees in place where you can.

Plan play times too. In summer, schools can schedule outdoor play for the morning, when surfaces are still cool. The monsoon brings heavy rain from June, so give the base a drainage slope. For the nearby steel city, see our

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Which colours stay coolest in strong sun?
items.a: Lighter shades absorb less heat than dark ones. We suggest light colours for surfaces children touch and darker ones for posts and roofs. Our roto-moulded range has more than 15 shades to choose from.

items.q: Do you supply colleges and campuses in western Odisha?
items.a: Yes. We work with schools, colleges, colonies and public bodies, and deliver by road anywhere in India. Installation is by our team or a dealer in eastern India.

Manufacturing defects are covered for three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Springs, bearings and spare parts get one year. Installation and maintenance must follow our instructions.
